judgments.reason: The dataset README explicitly cites the candidate paper (Niso et al., 2016) as the foundational publication describing the OMEGA archive.
The candidate paper, 'OMEGA: The Open MEG Archive,' is the foundational paper that introduces and describes the entire dataset collection (OMEGA).

The paper proposes MEG-BIDS, a principled data structure and standard for organizing and sharing MEG data, making it a technical specification/methodology, not a paper describing the specific OMEGA dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
